waivers.rationale: One-shot administrative backfill interpolates only fixed internal schema identifiers; values remain parameterized.
Promo artifacts and the promotion lock are group-writable only for the exact setgid artifact group; systemd UMask and namespace isolation exclude all other users.
The one-shot Promo migration shares its lock only with the exact setgid promo artifact group so web and import authorities preserve atomic pointer access.
Reporting refresh composes only fixed application-owned SQL fragments and parameterizes all business values.
